topic: Eye-friendly foods (general: greens, carrots, eggs, fish, fruits)

youtube.title: 5 foods your eyes love (No. 1 is in your kitchen) 🥬 #Shorts
youtube.description:
5 everyday foods your eyes love: a quick countdown.
கண்களுக்கு நல்ல 5 உணவுகள் – உங்கள் சமையலறையிலேயே!

• 5. Fruits like guava, orange and amla - rich in vitamin C.
• 4. Oily fish like sardine (mathi) and mackerel - omega-3 fats are good for the retina.
• 3. Eggs - the yolk has lutein and zeaxanthin, natural yellow pigments found in the centre of the retina.
• 2. Carrot, pumpkin and papaya - vitamin A helps you see in dim light.
• 1. Leafy greens like keerai and spinach - among the richest sources of lutein.
• The WHO notes vitamin A deficiency is a leading cause of preventable childhood blindness; a child who struggles to see at dusk should see an eye specialist.
• Good food supports your eyes but can't fix your power - get regular eye tests.

gmb.text: Five everyday foods that support healthy eyes: leafy greens like keerai and spinach (rich in lutein), carrots, pumpkin and papaya (vitamin A helps vision in dim light), eggs (the yolk has lutein and zeaxanthin), oily fish like sardine and mackerel (omega-3 fats for the retina), and fruits like guava, orange and amla (vitamin C). The WHO notes that lack of vitamin A is a leading cause of preventable blindness in children, so if a child struggles to see at dusk, see an eye specialist soon. Good food supports your eyes, but it cannot correct your power, so regular eye tests still matter. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
